title: Eleven Houses and One Hotel
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：service　|　正文 332 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 service 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My grandmother was ① in service for thirty-one years — eleven houses and one hotel — and she said the ② service nobody notices is the only kind that is any good, and that a house runs on the things nobody is thanked for. She was ③ of service to people who never learned her name, and she did not seem to mind.

The ④ service she could not bear was the visible kind: the bow, the smile, the 'madam', which she said is not service at all but a way of reminding a person that they have been served. She never once called anybody madam, not even the woman who paid her eleven pounds a month and who asked her to. She said service, properly done, is invisible, and that a house where you notice it is a house where it is being done badly.

She left ⑤ service in 1974, at sixty-one, and spent the next eleven years cleaning the church. The ⑥ servicing of the boiler she considered real work and charged eleven pounds for, once a year, in March, and she was the only person in the village who could do it.

In 1985 the ⑦ bus service to the village was cut and she wrote to the council eleven times about it, which is the only political thing she ever did. My father, who had done his ⑧ national service in 1961 and did not like to talk about it, said she had been in the harder ⑨ service of the two, and that he had only ever seen the easy one, and that he had been paid for his and she had not been paid for hers.

She died in 1996. There was a ⑩ service in the church she had cleaned for eleven years, and it was full of people she had worked for and never once named, and who came anyway. I have never been able to decide whether that was a kind of service she gave them or a kind they gave her.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 服务；侍候；服务态度
B. n. 服务工作；佣工职业（in service）
C. n. 公共服务；公用事业（the bus service）
D. n. 兵役；军种（national service）
E. 固定搭配：in service 在做佣工；在使用中
F. 固定搭配：be of service (to sb.) 对（某人）有用／有帮助
G. n. 检修；保养；维修（servicing）
H. n. 宗教仪式；礼拜（a church service）

items.q: was in service for thirty-one years
She was of service to people
The service she could not bear
the bus service to the village was cut
she had been in the harder service of the two
There was a service in the church

answers.why: in service 意为“做佣工、在帮佣”，祖母做了三十一年佣工，换了十一户人家和一家旅馆。
service 意为“服务”，她说没人注意到的服务才是唯一有用的。
be of service to sb. 意为“对某人有用、有帮助”，她对那些从不知道她名字的人很有用。
service 意为“服务（态度）”，她受不了的是那种看得见的服务。
service 意为“服务工作、佣工这一行”，她 1974 年六十一岁时离开了这一行。
servicing 意为“检修、保养”，锅炉的检修她认为是真活儿，一年收十一英镑。
the bus service 意为“公共汽车服务（公共交通）”，1985 年进村的班车被取消了。
national service 意为“兵役”，我父亲 1961 年服过兵役。
service 意为“（某一行）工作、侍候人的活儿”，父亲说她做的是两者中更苦的那一行。
a service 意为“宗教仪式、礼拜”，在她打扫了十一年的教堂里举行的葬礼仪式。
